item.title: Ookami Shounen wa Otoko no Ko ~Kyobou na Josou Ookami Shounen ga Ore ni Natsuku Made~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Frillboy
  • 発売日: 2014-08-17
  • スコア: 6.13/10 (20 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 狼少年は男の娘～凶暴な女装狼少年が俺に懐くまで～
  • 英語名: Ookami Shounen wa Otoko no Ko Kyobou na Josou Ookami Shounen ga Ore ni Natsuku Made

别名

  • The Wolf Comes Home

あらすじ

Yuji was the blessed, happy son of a distinguished family until the airplane crash. His parents were confirmed dead, and the body of his meek little brother Sora was never found. Several years passed, and Yuji now managed the family business.

item.description:

  • 日本語名: 憧れていた姉が男の娘でした～女装姉弟の生活事情～
  • 英語名: Akogareteita Ane ga Otokonoko Deshita Josou Kyoudai no Seikatsu Jijou

别名

  • The Sister I Yearned For Was The Brother I Never Knew I Had

あらすじ

Minase Haru was in love with the the school’s idol Minase Kaoru, who also happened to be his older sister. However, in spite of that, he just couldn’t be honest with himself and regretted it every day.
